Been today first meeting in PIBA to show original documents for partner visa . 
My gf from the Philippines married and started procedure in Philippines in 2024 and not finished yet . They told me that after the interview,  if we pass it , they will give her B1 only one year to finish the process and if divorce not finished , they will close the file .I was  reading in the internet that there are court ruling objecting this.  Anyone in the group knows anything about this or is in the same situation? Tx
